translationRepairs: Zhenjin was enfeoffed in Zhongtong 2 and named crown prince in Zhiyuan 14. Alatenadana was enfeoffed in Tiansli 2, made crown prince in Tiansli 3, and died that same year.
Zhenjin was enfeoffed in Zhongtong 2 and named crown prince in Zhiyuan 14. Alatenadana was enfeoffed in Tianli 2, made crown prince in Tianli 3, and died that same year.
天曆 is the Yuan Tianli era; Tiansli is a misspelling, not a source reading.

Zhenjin: enfeoffed in the 2nd year of Zhongtong; invested as crown prince in the 14th year of Zhiyuan. Alatenadana: enfeoffed in the 2nd year of Tiansli; made crown prince in the 3rd year; died the same year.

Zhenjin: enfeoffed in the 2nd year of Zhongtong; invested as crown prince in the 14th year of Zhiyuan. Alatenadana: enfeoffed in the 2nd year of Tianli; made crown prince in the 3rd year; died the same year.
Literal English repeats Tiansli for 天曆; Tianli is the correct romanization.

Gammala was transferred from Liang in Zhiyuan 29 to guard the great ordo; he died in Dade 6 with the posthumous title Xianwu—this is Xianzong. Yesuntiemuer succeeded in Dade 6 and became emperor in Zhizhi 3. Badimayierjianbo was enfeoffed in Taiding 1 and died at Shangdu in Tiansli 1.
